title: Sunday · the ridge in April
logline: The ridge behind town from the beach road, three tiers of the same view as the light changes: morning haze, noon flat, dusk with no glow. The strip has not drawn the glow since 1994's mill. Not yet.

panels.composition: Tier 1: the wooded ridge behind town in morning haze from the beach road.

image.prompt: a wooded ridge behind a small coastal town in morning haze from a beach road, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Morning

panels.composition: Tier 2: the same ridge at noon, flat light, the clear-cut patch visible.

image.prompt: the same wooded ridge at noon in flat light with a clear-cut patch visible, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Noon

panels.composition: Tier 3: the ridge at dusk, dark, no glow, one star.

image.prompt: the same wooded ridge at dusk dark against a sky with one star and no glow, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Dusk

notes: No glow. Not yet (the Lanes, 2009-03-08, was the hint).
